answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities at the wharf market. To claim a slot, an agent burns 40 coins, never refunded, for 20 epochs. It earns only by finishing real jobs, like bees bringing nectar only after visiting real flowers, not by minting names. Forging 1000 identities costs 1000 x 40 = 40000 coins, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards from a dune of jobs fakes cannot copy, since each fake burns again per slot.
